guitar.notes: Manu Chao plays varied guitars, no single iconic documented model.

tone.target: raw garage rock crunch with slight nasal fuzz
tone.profile: raw garage rock crunch with slight nasal fuzz
tone.summary: A gritty garage rock tone achieved with an OD boost for punchy attack, followed by Fuzz for nasal edge, running into a US Deluxe amp model and 2x12 cab for vintage warmth.
corrections: lean rawer than generic rock crunch

rig.name: Mano Negra - Mala Vida - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up stray hum and noise inherent in raw garage rock recordings.
Provide a punchy, mid-forward boost for the verse texture and attack.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is chosen over Blues OD/OD 9 to maintain a slightly dirtier, less polished grit suitable for garage rock.

blocks.purpose: Introduce the required nasal fuzz edge and raw grit.
Simulate the small tube combo/Vox Deluxe style amp for vintage warmth and mid-focus.
blocks.gap: The US Deluxe is the closest model to a Vox/Deluxe style low-wattage, mid-focused British combo.

blocks.purpose: Provide the required small cabinet sound (1x12 or 2x10) with vintage character.
blocks.gap: The US 2x12 is used as a proxy for the requested smaller, punchier cab size.

blocks.purpose: Fine-tune the tone by boosting mids and slightly rolling off extreme bass/treble for a focused garage sound.
Optional modulation for adding depth to the verse texture (kept off by default).
blocks.gap: Not required for this raw tone, but included as a potential textural element.

blocks.purpose: Add a subtle sense of space and room ambience without sounding overly polished.
blocks.gap: A slight Room effect is used to prevent the raw fuzz from sounding too dry, maintaining grit while adding depth.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism to better capture the small combo/vintage sound.

proposals.reason: The US 2x12 is a proxy; a smaller, vintage cab IR will improve authenticity.
proposals.expectedGain: More focused and authentic small combo tone.
